answer: The atlas assignment is published and shale records each panel. Shards are assigned from the ledge graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 770 identities would post 860 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
